comment: The fleet model chain's ONE source (issue #1199; shape introduced by #1140). ORDER IS THE CONTRACT: exactly one role=primary first, one or more role=fallback entries in list order, exactly one role=last_resort LAST. `make agent-profile-model-render` renders every lane's profile config from this file; `make agent-model-chain-check` refuses drift. The provider is the built-in `nous` provider (the Nous Portal session; the same https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1 endpoint) — a credential is a NAME only (AGENTS.md rule 3e): `key_env`, never a value. An entry MAY override `provider`/`base_url` per step, which is how the LOCAL Strata engine step (a non-Nous endpoint) rides in the same chain; a `nous` step carries ONLY `provider: nous` (adding `base_url`/`key_env` re-routes it to `custom` and 401s — measured on issue #1199).

measured.how: GET /v1/models with the Nous agent key: 415 models, exactly 5 carrying the `:free` pricing suffix, and every `model` id below is present in that payload with the `context_length` quoted below. The provider was then PROVEN end to end on this host: a scratch profile with `model: {provider: nous, default: meituan/longcat-2.5:free}` answered a real turn, and an alias `free-qwen4: {model: qwen/qwen4-max:free, provider: nous}` answered a real turn; the previous `custom` + `key_env: NOUS_API_KEY` shape answered HTTP 401 (invalid/blocked/out of funds).
measured.issue: owner directive of 2026-11-21 (provider nous, qwen4-free primary, longcat fallback, a local Strata step, deepseek last); the live read was re-run when this file was authored
